label: FEA race-poll aggregate
method: Weighted mean of eligible VoteHub public race polls in the 60 days through the as-of date. Weights: recency half-life 45 days, sqrt(sample size) capped 0.55x–2.10x, LV 1.1 / RV 1.0, partisan 0.78, repeated pollster 1/sqrt(1+prior weight). Same pollster+end date collapsed; internals excluded; LV/RV only; exact office/geography and named ballot matchup required; minimum two distinct pollsters. This is an FEA aggregate of VoteHub data (CC BY 4.0), not VoteHub’s published weighted average or a prediction.
